Iterate through structured table cells and Markdown output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/html', uri: 'https://example.com/html/simple_table.html'), {  })
result.results[0].tables.each do |table|
  puts table.cells
  puts table.markdown
end
```
